exposure: TALENs targeting exon 6 of porcine GGTA1 gene
outcome: Generation of GGTA1-knockout (GTKO) Diannan miniature pigs
Absence of galactose α-1,3-galactose epitopes (Gal expression) in fibroblasts, kidneys, and pancreas
cohort: Diannan miniature pig fetal fibroblasts were used as donor cells for somatic cell nuclear transfer, resulting in GTKO reconstructed embryos transferred into recipient gilts, which then produced GTKO aborted fetuses, stillborn fetuses, and live piglets.
finding: TALENs combined with SCNT were successfully used to generate GGTA1-knockout (GTKO) Diannan miniature piglets, demonstrating the complete absence of Gal epitopes.
